dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder how Glory is doing...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I wish I could return to Mondstadt to see her... But I can't. How can I let her know that her lover is a coward and a deserter?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: The best I can do now is clear out monsters and do my part to protect Mondstadt... and her.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Laugh if you want. I'm... I'm a useless man.
